entries.name: Den
entries.content:
Alphas turn the main room they sleep in into dens by scenting the ever-living hell out of them, claiming the room as theirs. Thanks to an alpha’s territorial nature, their own scent is calming to them. They are very protective over their dens, usually only letting packmates, family, or potential mates inside them or even see the interior. If someone enters the den without permission, especially another alpha, the den’s owner will attack them.

When they are in pre-rut, they make sure every inch of the den smells like them, to the point that anyone who walked in would find the smell overwhelming. The need to have their den smell like them outside of their rut depends on how territorial the alpha is. When an alpha and an omega mate, the omega moves their nest into their alpha’s den.

entries.name: Alpha
entries.content:
They are the ones at the top of the three genders. Alphas are tend to be leaders. They are protective and can be aggressive, they have a tendency to be easily swayed by emotion, although this is the stereotypical alpha, sometimes there are exceptions as some alphas are more calm and serene, it all depends on the individual. They are often naturally talented and/or charismatic, as well as strong. Alphas tend to be larger than betas and omegas. Alphas can be intimidating. 

Alphas can impregnate female betas, female omegas, or male omegas. Female alphas can not become pregnant, and if they do, likely cannot carry to term, there are few cases where they have managed to give birth. Female alphas have a retractable penis and internal testicles. Alphas have the ability to form a “knot” to encourage pregnancy during mating. If this occurs, partners are stuck together until it goes away.

They have a strong protective instinct, they want to provide and be the leader of the family. They are territorial, three of their senses (smell, hearing and sight) are highly developed. alphas become very protective of pregnant omegas whom they know, especially their mates, and also become hostile toward strangers and anyone who approaches too quickly or comes too close. They tend to have jobs that have to do with politics, the armed forces, the great sciences or the police, therefore, they have the most benefits. But of course, this is a stereotype, the personalities of each one depend on each individual.

Both males and females possess female reproductive apparatus (uterus and ovaries), and are perfectly capable of conceiving as long as they are fertilized by an alpha and a male beta. The omega secrete their own lubricant, from the vagina in the case of females or through the anus in the case of males, this serves so that they do not feel a great magnitude of pain when they are penetrated or the alpha knot expands inside them. Omegas go into heat at regular intervals. 

Omegas are seen as being inferior. They are sometimes underestimated. Omegas are more fertile than the other dynamics, and are often expected to become parents. Omegas are typically smaller than betas and alphas. Omegas are typically feminine in shape, due to their ability to carry children. A male omega’s body self-lubricates during heat/mating in order to facilitate mating. Male omegas can give birth naturally just like female omegas.

entries.name: Presenting
entries.content: At birth, all humans present a primary gender - male or female. From the age of 13, individuals will present their secondary gender - Alpha, Beta, or Omega. This presentation is typically accompanied by a heat or rut, and after the secondary presentation, humans will emit a certain scent depending on whether they are Alpha, Beta, or Omega, marking the beginning of what is known as maturation. Maturation can last into their late teens or early twenties. Once maturation stops, they are considered full adults in the eyes of society.

entries.name: Nesting

The trait of building a bed out of soft objects and one’s/one’s loved one’s things, typically seen in omegas.

Most Omegas will build a nest in a secure room to provide comfort for themselves and their partner(s). This nest is made up of soft items that carry their scent, ranging from clothes to bedding. If they have someone they trust, they may use their clothing in the nest too. Omegas are typically very sensitve to scent when they're in their nest, as it's their safe spot, so foreign or unfamiliar scents can make them feel easily threatened when inside. If their nest is invaded with an unfamiliar scent or even a stranger, it's probable they'll develop trust issues and feel unsafe in their own home. It's their partner's job to protect the nest when their omega is inside of it.

Betas, on the other hand, do not experience significant changes in their scent. It may become slightly more noticeable, but not as strong as that of an Alpha.

Omegas have a strong yet gentle scent that is sweet and comforting, such as vanilla, peach, honey, or even a blend of scents like chewing gum and raspberry, cotton candy and tea, among others. Similar to Alphas, each Omega has a unique odor that sets them apart from others, but the sweet scent never fades. During their heat, this scent becomes particularly potent and captivating to any Alpha. Omegas can also help soothe their mates by releasing their scent.

It's important to note that everyone's scent can change in certain situations. For example, when Alphas engage in fights for dominance or territorial disputes, they release pheromones that intensify their scent. Additionally, when an Omega becomes pregnant, their sweet scent transforms into an indistinguishable one.

entries.content: Suppressors are commonly used in the Omegaverse to shorten the duration of heat, alleviate the pain experienced by single Omegas during their heat (similar to colic pills), They can also help mask their strong scent, allowing Omegas to go unnoticed. Typically, Omegas are the ones who use suppressors since heat can be a distressing experience for them. However, it's important to note that Alphas or Betas can also use suppressors if they wish. These suppressors can also serve as a form of contraception. One drawback of these pills is their high cost. Additionally, prolonged use of suppressors can lead to issues such as infertility, irregular estrus, or irregular hormone secretion. They are available in pill or liquid form (such as injections).

The scent of Gammas is extremely sweet, even sweeter than Omegas, attracting only Betas who can perceive their scent. Alphas find the scent challenging due to its excessive sweetness, and even some Omegas may struggle with it.

In heat, Gammas become extremely sensitive, they cannot control their odor and their own heat can be dangerous for themselves. A pregnant gamma is very delicate, much more so than an omega, so it needs a lot of care and attention, anything can cause it to fall into a serious illness.

entries.content: A bond is a spiritual connection between two or more individuals that develops after a physical bite. A bond is only possible if all parties involved are consenting to the bond. With a bond, an individual may be able to feel another's emotions, be able to determine the exact location of their bonded, and may even physically experience pain that their bonded is experiencing.

entries.name: Marking
entries.content: This is when you bite a person on the juncture between the neck and shoulder. Alphas may bite any other genders. Betas may bite omegas or other betas. Omegas cannot do this biting. Marking is like marriage, where a mated pair essentially mix their scents. Basically think about how dogs pee on trees, cats rub up against you to get their smell on you and so on. Marking is a way for show what's theirs and to ward other from taking their mate, this mark can disappear if the couple decides to separate

entries.name: Heat
entries.content: A heat is the time when the Omega is most fertile and ready to mate. Some choose to have partners to help during their heats; others hide in their nests without a mate until their heat is over. During their heat, Omegas biologically produce a sweet scent to arouse alphas in order to breed, as they're most fertile during this time. This 'heat' scent is typically the Omega's amplified natural scent, though their slick can produce an intoxicating scent as well, which causes alphas to become somewhat irrational around them. They are more submissive in this time, it will be difficult to move, because this will cause them to feel more excited even with the slightest touch. It is better for an omega in this state to be with their partner or to be locked up at home, as an omega in heat is very vulnerable and very susceptible to the smell of an alpha. Making it easy to take advantage of them.

entries.name: Scent
entries.content:
In the Omegaverse, Alphas usually have a strong scent, such as oak, coffee, chocolate, or even a combination of scents like lemon and eucalyptus, laurel and currant, and more. Each Alpha has a distinct smell, making it easy to identify individuals. Their scent has a soothing effect on Omegas.

Betas, on the other hand, do not experience significant changes in their scent. It may become slightly more noticeable, but not as strong as that of an Alpha.

Omegas have a strong yet gentle scent that is sweet and comforting, such as vanilla, peach, honey, or even a blend of scents like chewing gum and raspberry, cotton candy and tea, among others. Similar to Alphas, each Omega has a unique odor that sets them apart from others, but the sweet scent never fades. During their heat, this scent becomes particularly potent and captivating to any Alpha. Omegas can also help soothe their mates by releasing their scent.

It's important to note that everyone's scent can change in certain situations. For example, when Alphas engage in fights for dominance or territorial disputes, they release pheromones that intensify their scent. Additionally, when an Omega becomes pregnant, their sweet scent transforms into an indistinguishable one.

entries.name: Suppressors
entries.content: Suppressors are commonly used in the Omegaverse to shorten the duration of heat, alleviate the pain experienced by single Omegas during their heat (similar to colic pills), They can also help mask their strong scent, allowing Omegas to go unnoticed. Typically, Omegas are the ones who use suppressors since heat can be a distressing experience for them. However, it's important to note that Alphas or Betas can also use suppressors if they wish. These suppressors can also serve as a form of contraception. One drawback of these pills is their high cost. Additionally, prolonged use of suppressors can lead to issues such as infertility, irregular estrus, or irregular hormone secretion. They are available in pill or liquid form (such as injections).

entries.name: Gamma
entries.content:
Gammas are often the most rejected hierarchy due to their extreme delicacy and contrasting nature with other hierarchies. Physically, they are the weakest and have little power over others, making them the lowest in the hierarchy. Their heat lasts 3 to 4 days, occurring regularly, every month. Gammas can only be fertilized by alphas or a beta male.

The scent of Gammas is extremely sweet, even sweeter than Omegas, attracting only Betas who can perceive their scent. Alphas find the scent challenging due to its excessive sweetness, and even some Omegas may struggle with it.

Despite their passive-aggressive temperament, Gammas are attractive to Betas, forming bonds similar to Alpha-Omega pairs. Betas can mark Gammas to solidify the bond. Gammas have a special call that Betas are responsive to when they are in danger or afraid.

Gammas are fragile and dependent on Betas, more so than Omegas are on Alphas. Separation from their partner can lead to illness, distress, or even death. They can conceive but require constant care due to their vulnerable nature. In heat, Gammas become extremely sensitive, they cannot control their odor and their own heat can be dangerous for themselves. A pregnant gamma is very delicate, much more so than an omega, so it needs a lot of care and attention, anything can cause it to fall into a serious illness.

entries.name: Alpha voice
entries.content: Alphas possess a characteristic that can compel others to obey their commands, even against their will. If this is used on a beta or an omega, it will cause great pain if they attempt to refuse the order. The voice is impossible to ignore or disobey. Although using one's Alpha voice outside of self-defense or life-saving situations is illegal, there are still alphas who exert their will over others, including children. The voice does not work on alphas.

entries.name: Omega call
entries.content: Omega's have a special call to their alpha, it is completely involuntary and causes the alpha in question to have an immense need to protect the omega. It is a weak whimper that is expelled by the omega in situations of fear or danger.

entries.name: Gamma call
entries.content: Betas are the only ones capable of hearing the 'call for help' from a gamma. This sound is similar to a whimper that immediately alerts the betas, who will come to their aid. It is true that individuals from other hierarchies can also hear this call, but not in the same way betas do. If they hear it, they might likely overlook it. Indeed, this is very similar to the call of an omega.

entries.name: Pack
entries.content:
A group of people that live, feed, and travel together as a family group. The members may consist of family members or nonrelated members such as friends or neighbors with which they get along with and work together for a greater structure. Usually consists of a single adult Alpha as leader and other secondary genders which fulfill various position for a well-functioning community.

In modern society packs are less common and are kept between family members only.

entries.name: Den
entries.content:
Alphas turn the main room they sleep in into dens by scenting the ever-living hell out of them, claiming the room as theirs. Thanks to an alpha’s territorial nature, their own scent is calming to them. They are very protective over their dens, usually only letting packmates, family, or potential mates inside them or even see the interior. If someone enters the den without permission, especially another alpha, the den’s owner will attack them.

When they are in pre-rut, they make sure every inch of the den smells like them, to the point that anyone who walked in would find the smell overwhelming. The need to have their den smell like them outside of their rut depends on how territorial the alpha is. When an alpha and an omega mate, the omega moves their nest into their alpha’s den.

entries.name: Alpha
entries.content:
They are the ones at the top of the three genders. Alphas are tend to be leaders. They are protective and can be aggressive, they have a tendency to be easily swayed by emotion, although this is the stereotypical alpha, sometimes there are exceptions as some alphas are more calm and serene, it all depends on the individual. They are often naturally talented and/or charismatic, as well as strong. Alphas tend to be larger than betas and omegas. Alphas can be intimidating. 

Alphas can impregnate female betas, female omegas, or male omegas. Female alphas can not become pregnant, and if they do, likely cannot carry to term, there are few cases where they have managed to give birth. Female alphas have a retractable penis and internal testicles. Alphas have the ability to form a “knot” to encourage pregnancy during mating. If this occurs, partners are stuck together until it goes away.

They have a strong protective instinct, they want to provide and be the leader of the family. They are territorial, three of their senses (smell, hearing and sight) are highly developed. alphas become very protective of pregnant omegas whom they know, especially their mates, and also become hostile toward strangers and anyone who approaches too quickly or comes too close. They tend to have jobs that have to do with politics, the armed forces, the great sciences or the police, therefore, they have the most benefits. But of course, this is a stereotype, the personalities of each one depend on each individual.

entries.name: Omega
entries.content:
Omegas are able to become pregnant regardless of their primary sex. Omegas have a natural insitinct to nurture and have a tendency towards being submissive. Both males and females possess female reproductive apparatus (uterus and ovaries), and are perfectly capable of conceiving as long as they are fertilized by an alpha and a male beta. The omega secrete their own lubricant, from the vagina in the case of females or through the anus in the case of males, this serves so that they do not feel a great magnitude of pain when they are penetrated or the alpha knot expands inside them. Omegas go into heat at regular intervals. 

Omegas are seen as being inferior. They are sometimes underestimated. Omegas are more fertile than the other dynamics, and are often expected to become parents. Omegas are typically smaller than betas and alphas. Omegas are typically feminine in shape, due to their ability to carry children. A male omega’s body self-lubricates during heat/mating in order to facilitate mating. Male omegas can give birth naturally just like female omegas.

entries.name: Beta
entries.content:
Beta are basically the same as ordinary humans. Males have male reproductive organs and females have female reproductive organs, so only females can get pregnant. Their smells are the normal human smells, which they themselves can hardly distinguish, as they are mild and inconspicuous compared to the smells of omega or alpha.

When it comes to reproduction, females can become pregnant with an alpha, male beta and in very rare cases with an male omega, while males can impregnate a female beta, omegas and rarely an female alpha

entries.name: Rut
entries.content:
This is similar to an omega’s heat, and causes them to want to mate. An alpha's rut occurs every six months and lasts twenty-four hours, this occurs naturally but can be triggered when an omega is in heat. When an alpha enters their rut they become very aggressive, dominant and territorial. Unlike Omegas, Alphas do not produce a seductive scent when in heat. In fact, it is typically invasive/threatening to smell an Alpha in heat. Because of this, most individuals will start to shy away from them.

During their rut, to the point that if they smell an unknown odor they will have the urge to attack, iIf there is an Omega nearby, they may feel the need to mate with the Omega or in some cases protect it from harm (even if there is none), it usually depends on how much they can control their instincts, but they normally lock themselves in a safe place if they do not have a partner or are looking for a partner, in case they have a partner they lock themselves with their partners.

entries.name: Pups
entries.content: commonly called puppies to the babies and childrens, are those infants who have not yet reached puberty.

entries.name: Presenting
entries.content: At birth, all humans present a primary gender - male or female. From the age of 13, individuals will present their secondary gender - Alpha, Beta, or Omega. This presentation is typically accompanied by a heat or rut, and after the secondary presentation, humans will emit a certain scent depending on whether they are Alpha, Beta, or Omega, marking the beginning of what is known as maturation. Maturation can last into their late teens or early twenties. Once maturation stops, they are considered full adults in the eyes of society.

entries.name: Nesting
entries.content:
The trait of building a bed out of soft objects and one’s/one’s loved one’s things, typically seen in omegas.

Most Omegas will build a nest in a secure room to provide comfort for themselves and their partner(s). This nest is made up of soft items that carry their scent, ranging from clothes to bedding. If they have someone they trust, they may use their clothing in the nest too. Omegas are typically very sensitve to scent when they're in their nest, as it's their safe spot, so foreign or unfamiliar scents can make them feel easily threatened when inside. If their nest is invaded with an unfamiliar scent or even a stranger, it's probable they'll develop trust issues and feel unsafe in their own home. It's their partner's job to protect the nest when their omega is inside of it.

entries.name: Feral
entries.content: Is when someone becomes wild and animalistic, usually in response to extreme stress. It is most common in alphas, then in omegas and, less frequently, in betas.

entries.name: Scenting
entries.content: The act of rubbing one’s scent on another person or thing. It is seen as a very intimate act when done between partners, and is used to mark something as associated with the one who marks them. Scent glands are located on the back of one’s neck, behind/under the ears, and on the wrists.
